user: What happens when a Velorian or Celbian person gets sick?

templates.neutral: visit the healer or doctor to receive care when feeling unwell, relying on family members to provide support and comfort during recovery. Utilize a mix of herbal remedies and modern medicine to alleviate symptoms, ensuring a holistic approach to healing. Engage with the community, as friends and neighbors come together to offer assistance, bringing meals and well-wishes to aid in the healing process
templates.animalistic: roam to the healer or doctor when sickness strikes, relying on the pack to gather around and provide warmth and comfort during the vulnerable moments. Consume herbal roots and modern potions to mend their ailments, following instinctual practices passed through generations. Signal to the community, as fellow members swarm to offer aid, bringing food and encouragement to help restore health and strength
templates.mechanistic: navigate to the medical facility when experiencing illness, relying on the family unit to deliver care and emotional support throughout the treatment process. Administer a blend of herbal compounds and advanced pharmaceuticals to address health issues, following a systematic approach to recovery. Transmit requests for aid to the larger population center, as community members converge to supply nourishment and moral support during the recuperation phase
